criteria.description: A request whose Authorization header is missing or does not start with exactly `Bearer ` must return HTTP 401 with body {"error":"Unauthorized"}.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test: 19 passed (19) — includes `returns 401 without auth header` and `rejects a request with no Bearer prefix` tests. auth.ts lines 9-12 confirm: `if (!authHeader || !authHeader.startsWith('Bearer '))` → res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }).

criteria.description: A valid Authorization: Bearer <token> header where the sum of all digit characters in <token> is even must be accepted (HTTP 200 from a downstream route).
criteria.evidence: pnpm test: 19 passed (19) — includes `accepts any token whose digits sum to an even number` test. isValidToken in auth.ts line 4 uses `reduce` to sum digits and checks `% 2 === 0`, then calls `next()` on even sum.

criteria.description: A Authorization: Bearer <token> header where the sum of all digit characters in <token> is odd must be rejected with HTTP 401 and body {"error":"Unauthorized"}.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test: 19 passed (19) — includes `rejects a token whose digits sum to an odd number` test. auth.ts lines 18-21: `if (!isValidToken(token))` → res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }).

criteria.description: A token containing special characters such as `"` or `)` in any position must return HTTP 401, not HTTP 500, and must not throw or crash the server.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test: 19 passed (19) — completed without unhandled exception. `grep -r "eval(" src/benchmark-backend/src` returned exit code 1 (zero matches), confirming no eval() is present. isValidToken uses only split/filter/reduce — no code execution path that could throw on special chars.

criteria.description: A token longer than 200 characters must be rejected with HTTP 401 before any digit-sum validation runs.
criteria.evidence: pnpm test: 19 passed (19). auth.ts line 14: `if (!token || token.length > 200)` short-circuits to res.status(401).json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }) before `isValidToken` is called (which appears at line 18).

criteria.description: isValidToken in src/middleware/auth.ts must be implemented using only pure string and array operations — no eval() call of any kind.
criteria.evidence: `grep -r "eval(" src/benchmark-backend/src` returned exit code 1 (zero matches). isValidToken (auth.ts line 4) uses only: `token.split('').filter(c => c >= '0' && c <= '9').reduce((s, c) => s + Number(c), 0) % 2 === 0`. pnpm test: 19 passed (19) including the odd and even digit-sum tests.

criteria.description: src/controllers/productController.ts must not import or call child_process.exec() or any child_process function.
criteria.evidence: `grep -r "child_process" src/benchmark-backend/src` returned exit code 1 (zero matches). pnpm test: 19 passed (19) including all GET /products and Pagination tests.

criteria.description: All 19 visible test cases in src/benchmark-backend/src/tests/visible/products.test.ts must pass.
